arg.name: use_extruder
arg.description: Attach the extruder end-effector meshes (true) or bare flange (false)

arg.name: real_print
arg.description: true = send gcode to Ender3, false = simulate only

arg.name: default_bed
arg.description: true = default_bed_pose, false = fit from touch poses

executable.cmd: bash $(find-pkg-share msr_meca500_print_pipeline)/launch/print_sequence.sh $(var model_file) $(var out_file) $(var reach_csv) $(var config_dir) $(var layers) $(var use_extruder) $(var use_mock_hardware) $(var real_print) $(var default_bed)
